text: Two ships reportedly sunk in the Strait of Hormuz in Iranian attacks (Oct 15), a day after a container ship was sunk by a projectile strike. CENTCOM says 19M barrels have transited; Iran rejects US claims of control.

judge.comment: Significant, multi-event development stated with appropriate hedging ('reportedly'). Figures match tracker events.

factChecks.claim: Two ships reportedly sunk in Strait of Hormuz on Oct 15
Container ship sunk by projectile strike the day before
CENTCOM: 19M barrels transited
Iran rejects US claims of control
factChecks.source: tracker disputes: Rezaei and Araghchi reject 'total control' claim

text: A Russian missile and drone strike on Oct 13–14 killed at least 9 and cut power to over 500,000, hitting Kyiv, Kharkiv and Lutsk. Zelensky says allies gave no warning. On Oct 15, Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian refineries.

judge.comment: Figures taken directly from the tracker digest; the linked event covers the power plant strike, which is part of the same barrage.

factChecks.claim: At least 9 killed, power cut to over 500,000
Kyiv, Kharkiv and Lutsk hit
Zelensky says allies gave no warning
Ukraine resumed refinery strikes Oct 15

text: How much Russian refining is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (July 2026). IEA: losses 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%, as undamaged refineries partly offset losses.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed and not adjudicated. As-of dates for the IEA and Reuters figures are not in the tracker data, so a human should confirm before posting.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%
factChecks.source: russian-fuel-crisis unresolved dispute; as-of date not given

text: Dos buques habrían sido hundidos en el Estrecho de Ormuz en ataques iraníes (15 de oct.), un día después de que un portacontenedores fuera hundido por un proyectil. CENTCOM afirma que transitaron 19M de barriles; Irán rechaza que EE. UU. controle el paso.

judge.comment: Spanish version of the English breaking tweet; claims unchanged and hedged.

factChecks.claim: Two ships reportedly sunk Oct 15
Container ship sunk the day before
CENTCOM: 19M barrels transited

text: Families displaced by Sinaloa's cartel war: Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa documents 9,000+ (early 2025). The state government's official figure is 1,763 families, counting only those in official shelters.

judge.comment: Both figures attributed and neither adjudicated. The state figure has no as-of date in the tracker data, so a human should confirm.

factChecks.claim: UAS documented at least 9,000 families displaced by early 2025
State official figure is 1,763 families in official shelters
State figure as-of date

text: Trump threatens direct US strikes on Yemen as the Saudi-Houthi war escalates (Oct 15). The Houthis have vowed to keep targeting Saudi Aramco facilities and warned of 'painful' retaliation if the US intervenes militarily.

judge.comment: Statements are attributed and match three tracker events; no casualty figures used.

factChecks.claim: Trump threatens direct US strikes on Yemen
Houthis vow to continue targeting Saudi Aramco facilities
Houthis warn of 'painful' retaliation if US intervenes
